definition.policy:
(document_id IN ( SELECT guide_documents.id
   FROM guide_documents
  WHERE (guide_documents.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))
definition.function_filter: s.document_id IN (SELECT d.id FROM public.guide_documents d WHERE d.owner_id = auth.uid())

timing_method.large_users: 20 searches each after one warm-up. Each query vector runs twice with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF) and twice plainly, timed by pg_stat_statements. The first run of a new vector is slow on this free-tier project however it is timed; explain_p50_ms is the repeat.
timing_method.other_users: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) with per-node timing, first run of each vector; their p50s are upper bounds
